items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Vince Gill and then that new young girl, Leann Rimes? She’s a fabulous singer, got a great voice and she’s just true blue, you know right in there.

ctx.x: Vince Gill and then that new young girl, Leann Rimes? She’s a fabulous singer, got a great voice and she’s just true blue, you know right in there. It’s the kind of stuff you like to hear.

Well it’s curious you say that things are becoming too generic. I mean world music is now a category you can go to the record stores and see world music. I guess I had a question there I’m not sure what it was. Except that—
